summary: Independent Bank Corp., the Massachusetts bank holding company for Rockland Trust Company, furnished a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting that its board declared a regular quarterly common stock dividend of $0.64 per share, payable October 9, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on September 28, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend declaration under Items 8.01 and 9.01, with a press release as Exhibit 99.1; no advisor, stake, premium, or transaction mechanics are involved, and no risk-arb angle applies.
